question: Can Shaiva ever be refuted by Vaishnava words?
premises: by increasing superiority the later overcomes the earlier
the Shaiva is never to be refuted by Vaishnava words
inference: Later-superior Shaiva stands unrefuted by rival words.
plain_english: By increasing superiority overcoming prior upon prior — the Shaiva is never to be refuted by Vaishnava words.
